business_problem: Capital markets involve huge amounts of information that need to be synthesized and analyzed. "For our lawyers, it’s always very busy," explains David Wang, Chief Innovation Officer at Cooley.
solution_summary: Capital markets involve huge amounts of information that need to be synthesized and analyzed. "For our lawyers, it’s always very busy," explains David Wang, Chief Innovation Officer at Cooley. "When there’s an IPO, there are thousands of things that need to be done constantly." Cooley’s GO Public offering uses ChatGPT Work to surface issues earlier, focus expertise, and help clients reach market faster. Cooley developed GO Public, a proprietary AI product offering built on ChatGPT Work. Its agentic harness analyzes information so lawyers can review and validate the work. The workflow comes together into a tailored starting point for an IPO.
